Test class weighting against the otherwise matched BGE control.

known_limitations: Only three independently identified remediation source families are available.
Source-family holdout evidence covers the remediation 810 rather than every historical source family.
Source-family metadata and structural validation do not prove semantic independence.
Development model-selection evidence is not a substitute for fresh final-holdout evidence.
The bounded candidate set tests only predeclared low-cost hypotheses.

selection.next_required_contract_ambiguity: Step 29G does not declare a failure-path next_required; execution fails closed without authorizing Step 29I.

numerical_tie_tolerance.rule: Treat numeric criteria as tied when absolute_difference is less than or equal to the absolute tolerance.

selection_rule.winner_interpretation: Best eligible candidate under the frozen V2-C6 development evaluation contract; not production-ready and not finally accepted.
